source_metadata.question: The solid shown was formed by cutting a right circular cylinder in half. If the base has a radius of 6 cm and the height is 10 cm, what is the total surface area, in terms of $\pi$, of the solid? <image1>
source_metadata.subject: solid geometry

target.visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
target.left_evidence: The dashed curved half of the lower circular boundary of the cut cylinder.
target.right_evidence: The horizontal dashed line extending rightward from the upper-left vertex.
target.left_meaning: It represents the rear curved base boundary that is hidden from this viewing direction.
target.right_meaning: It is a horizontal auxiliary construction line through the upper vertex of the plane diagram.
target.reason: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashes extend a horizontal reference from the top vertex in a plane trigonometric construction. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
